name: Fernando Ramos
role: Associate Professor at Instituto Superior Técnico
secondary_role: Senior Researcher at INESC-ID, member of DPSS
cover_alt: Illustration of Fernando Ramos with programmable networking research and projects
intro: I'm a computer scientist interested in how we design, program, and accelerate networks and systems. My research spans Internet architecture, programmable data planes, network security, and the increasingly exciting intersection of AI/ML and networking—in both directions. I enjoy pushing the boundaries of what networks can do, especially when it makes them more flexible, secure, and blazingly fast.
